package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "runtime"
    "runtime/pprof"
    "time"
)

// A build overlay adds this sampler only to diagnostic binaries. File markers
// bracket the transfer, so catalog setup and final whole-file hashing stay out.
func init() {
    directory := os.Getenv("WS_PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PROFILE")
    if directory == "" { return }
    go func() {
        control := filepath.Join(directory, "native-profile-control")
        ticker := time.NewTicker(25 * time.Millisecond)
        defer ticker.Stop()
        var cpu *os.File
        var samples *os.File
        active := false
        var previous string
        for range ticker.C {
            raw, err := os.ReadFile(control)
            if err != nil { continue }
            command := string(raw)
            if command == "start" && previous != command {
                cpu, err = os.Create(filepath.Join(directory, "sender-cpu.pprof"))
                if err != nil { return }
                if pprof.StartCPUProfile(cpu) != nil { cpu.Close(); return }
                samples, err = os.Create(filepath.Join(directory, "sender-memory.ndjson"))
                if err != nil { pprof.StopCPUProfile(); cpu.Close(); return }
                active = true
                os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "native-profile-ready"), []byte("ready"), 0600)
            }
            if active {
                var memory runtime.MemStats
                runtime.ReadMemStats(&memory)
                json.NewEncoder(samples).Encode(map[string]any{
                    "at": time.Now().UnixMilli(), "heapAlloc": memory.HeapAlloc,
                    "heapInuse": memory.HeapInuse, "totalAlloc": memory.TotalAlloc,
                    "gc": memory.NumGC, "pauseTotalNs": memory.PauseTotalNs,
                    "goroutines": runtime.NumGoroutine(),
                })
            }
            if command == "stop" && active {
                pprof.StopCPUProfile()
                cpu.Close()
                samples.Close()
                os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "native-profile-stopped"), []byte("stopped"), 0600)
                return
            }
            previous = command
        }
    }()
}
